$$I = 2\sum_{\substack{k \equiv n \pmod{2} \\ 0 \le k \le n}} \frac{a_k}{n+k+1}.$$

The denominators $n+k+1$ for $k = n, n-2, n-4, \ldots$ are $2n+1, 2n-1, 2n-3, \ldots$, which are exactly the **odd integers in $[n+1,\, 2n+1]$**.
